message: Hi Alex, it's Maria at Bright Dentistry, sounds good, let's do it. How do I pay and when do you start?
reply:
Hi Maria, great to hear! I'll send a secure invoice today — you can pay by card or bank transfer, due before I start. Once that's settled I'll begin the fix pack, typically wrapped within 5-7 business days. I'll also flag the care plan option afterward in case you want ongoing upkeep. Talk soon!

Alex
